description: Update webhook. Change the URL, events, batch size, contact opt-in, or turn the webhook on or off. Re-enabling clears its failure count. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

event_types.description: Event types to send, e.g. `["prospect.added"]`. `prospect.*` subscribes to every prospect event and `*` to everything.

is_active.description: `true` re-enables an endpoint that was turned off or disabled after failures.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_patch_webhooks_id
